overview.text: The Forest Flame Snake is a mildly venomous snake of Central and South America, usually ringed with red and black.

identification.text: Usually red (sometimes white towards the front) and black rings or crossbands; the colouring varies.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Up to about 91 cm, including a 22 cm tail.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: South-eastern Mexico through Central America to much of South America, and Trinidad and Tobago.

habitat.text: Forest and savanna, up to about 2,000 m.

diet.text: Lizards, frogs and tadpoles, small rodents and other mammals, birds and their eggs.

recognise.text: Red and black rings or bands.
